## Signed close publication failure

The F18 close command for `immolated-holohedral-waterdogs` returned exit 0 with a signed transition from `in_progress` to `closed` at commit `7fee4acbfa570b834b2bc917ce5febbc3e1b7862`. During the same command, tracker publication failed three times after automatic recovery because `origin/tickets` advanced. The reported local backlog grew from 45 commits to 57 commits and then to 70 commits.

Each failure was a non-fast-forward rejection for `HEAD -> tickets`. The command stated that the events were committed locally and would publish on the next successful push. A serialized `git fetch origin` completed before this occurrence was appended. This occurrence shows that the transient ref race can affect a signed close after the gate passes, even when the command reports success.
